Visitor Resources | General Transportation Announcements | Campus Map | ## General Transportation Announcements
- UMass Boston now offers free e-bike and e-scooter charging at the West Garage Secured Shelter with 13 Saris Power Posts; simply register your bike through Project 529 for Beaconcard access. Learn more about bike parking and facilities . ## Visitor Resources
We're delighted that you are interested in visiting UMass Boston! Below you will find resources for planning your visit to campus. ## Campus Map
Our campus plaza is undergoing a complete transformation into a lush, green quadrangle. Please refer to our campus map as a guide for traveling across campus. Our campus plaza is undergoing a complete transformation into a lush, green quadrangle. Please refer to our campus map as a guide for traveling across campus. ## Visitor Parking Options & Directions
If arriving by car, we advise you to park in the West Garage, the Quad Lot or Lot D, depending on your ultimate campus destination. We also offer on-campus parking in the Campus Center Garage (limited availability), and off-campus parking at a discounted rate in Bayside. ## Public Transportation
UMass Boston is located less than a mile from JFK/UMass station. Our campus is accessible by shuttle service, bike or walking. To plan your trip to JFK/UMass station, please use the MBTA’s Trip Planner. Find more information about Bluebikes on our Commuting Options & Resources page.
